row.title: Graph skips underscore bookkeeping tables
row.body: DATAGRAPH-1: tables whose name starts with an underscore (_migrations, _copy_progress, _cf_KV) are D1 and migration bookkeeping, not system data; read into the graph they only produced orphan findings and the item KG-ORPHANS-_copy_progress. SKIP_TABLE now drops every leading-underscore table; the step closes that item on its next pass when the finding stops firing.
